name: m3-fix-quota
coordination:
Other lanes run at the same time; do not edit their scopes:
- `m3-fix-integrate` owns src/integrate/**, src/commands/integrate.ts and src/commands/land.ts.
- `m3-fix-generated` owns src/shepherd/merge.ts, src/commands/integration.ts, src/commands/generated.ts, src/commands/verify.ts, src/commands/review.ts, src/verify/**, src/review/** and test/e2e/**.
